body_long:
Aman Group has a third brand. After Aman and Janu comes Atma, built around sport, wellness and what the group calls "performance living". Its global partner is Novak Djokovic. The group confirmed the launch on 10 November 2026, as reported the same day by Skift and HOTELS.

## What Atma means

In Sanskrit, atma means the spirit, or the true self. The brand brings together a hotel, branded residences and a private members' club, and the group says it will span both urban and remote settings.

## The first address: Miami

Atma Miami will rise on the Brickell waterfront, on Biscayne Bay, with completion expected in 2031. The tower reaches 1,049 feet, which The Real Deal describes as the tallest height allowed in Miami under Federal Aviation Administration rules. SHoP Architects designed it, with interiors by Studio Paolo Ferrari.

Residences range from one-bedroom homes to six-bedroom penthouses. No room count has been disclosed for the hotel.

## A wellness centre built around the court

At the heart of the project sits a 120,000 sq ft spa and wellness centre, designed in partnership with Djokovic. It brings together indoor tennis and padel courts, a medical wellness centre, a thermal spa, conditioning labs, and yoga and personal training studios. An invitation-only, racquet-focused club, the Atma Club, completes the offer; residence owners will have priority to join.

## Djokovic's role

Novak Djokovic, winner of 24 Grand Slam titles, is Atma's global partner, in a multi-year agreement. He will lead the brand's longevity, nutrition, racquet and wellness programmes. He describes Atma as a brand that "mirrors my own philosophy so closely". The partnership extends a relationship that began in August 2024, when Aman named him its first global wellness advisor.

## Who is behind it

The tower is developed by OKO Group and Oak Row Equities. Skift reports that OKO is owned by Vlad Doronin, Chairman and CEO of Aman Group, who calls the launch "a new awakening in hospitality". According to The Real Deal, the 4.25-acre site was acquired late last year for $520 million, a record for a South Florida development site. Financing terms have not been disclosed.

## The signal

After the spa comes the court. Luxury hotels no longer sell only rest: they sell how guests will feel, train and play. With Atma, Aman turns wellness from an amenity into a brand of its own, and puts one of the most disciplined athletes of his generation at its centre. For hoteliers, the lesson is clear: tennis and padel courts, recovery spaces and medical expertise are becoming part of the luxury product, not extras around it.
summary: Aman Group launches Atma, its third brand after Aman and Janu, with Novak Djokovic as global partner. The first address, Atma Miami, is a 1,049-foot Brickell tower due in 2031, with a 120,000 sq ft spa and wellness centre, indoor tennis and padel courts and a private racquet club.
